headline: Mexican peso recovers ground against the dollar after breaking the 19-unit barrier
summary: The peso gained ground against the dollar after a day of sharp depreciation, following a fall in the greenback. The currency had broken the 19-per-dollar level for the first time since June 2025 the previous day.
why: The Mexican peso is a widely traded emerging-market currency, and its level against the dollar affects inflation, dollar-denominated debt and foreign portfolio flows into Mexico.
original_headline: Peso mexicano recupera terreno frente al dólar tras romper la barrera de 19 unidades
